stateKeys.name: reason
stateKeys.type: string, why the run ended early ('' otherwise)

specialRules.name: accepted-and-declined-are-disjoint
specialRules.note: Every acceptor has exactly two branches and they never overlap. A DECLINED branch calls reject(reason) and returns BEFORE writing any next-state field, so post == pre. An ACCEPTED branch writes next-state fields and never calls reject. There is no accept-with-reason: a transition that moves the run is not a rejection, even when it is moving the run to a terminal failure state.

specialRules.name: start-only-from-idle
specialRules.note: START is ACCEPTED in 'idle' only, and writes phase='npm-test'. In any other state it is a DECLINED branch: reject('already-started') before writing.

specialRules.name: npm-test-completes-into-git-add
specialRules.note: In state 'npm-test' ONLY, VERIFY_PASSED is an ACCEPTED transition: it writes phase='git-add' and does NOT reject.

specialRules.name: npm-test-failure-ends-the-run
specialRules.note: In state 'npm-test' ONLY, VERIFY_FAILED is an ACCEPTED transition: it writes phase='blocked' and the reason, and does NOT reject. A transition into a terminal failure state is accepted, not a rejection.

specialRules.name: git-add-completes-into-git-commit
specialRules.note: In state 'git-add' ONLY, GIT_ADD_DONE is an ACCEPTED transition: it writes phase='git-commit' and does NOT reject.

specialRules.name: git-add-failure-ends-the-run
specialRules.note: In state 'git-add' ONLY, GIT_ADD_FAILED is an ACCEPTED transition: it writes phase='blocked' and the reason, and does NOT reject. A transition into a terminal failure state is accepted, not a rejection.

specialRules.name: git-commit-completes-into-git-push
specialRules.note: In state 'git-commit' ONLY, GIT_COMMIT_DONE is an ACCEPTED transition: it writes phase='git-push' and does NOT reject.

specialRules.name: git-commit-failure-ends-the-run
specialRules.note: In state 'git-commit' ONLY, GIT_COMMIT_FAILED is an ACCEPTED transition: it writes phase='blocked' and the reason, and does NOT reject. A transition into a terminal failure state is accepted, not a rejection.

specialRules.name: git-push-completes-into-done
specialRules.note: In state 'git-push' ONLY, GIT_PUSH_DONE is an ACCEPTED transition: it writes phase='done' and does NOT reject.

specialRules.name: git-push-failure-ends-the-run
specialRules.note: In state 'git-push' ONLY, GIT_PUSH_FAILED is an ACCEPTED transition: it writes phase='blocked' and the reason, and does NOT reject. A transition into a terminal failure state is accepted, not a rejection.

specialRules.name: stale-completions-reject
specialRules.note: Each completion action is awaited by exactly one state: VERIFY_PASSED and VERIFY_FAILED by 'npm-test', GIT_ADD_DONE and GIT_ADD_FAILED by 'git-add', GIT_COMMIT_DONE and GIT_COMMIT_FAILED by 'git-commit', GIT_PUSH_DONE and GIT_PUSH_FAILED by 'git-push'. In ANY OTHER state that action is a DECLINED branch: reject('stale-completion') and return before writing. Several sessions may share these orders, so a stale report is an ordinary observable event, never a fault.
specialRules.whenState: any state that does not await the action
specialRules.whenAction: VERIFY_PASSED | VERIFY_FAILED | GIT_ADD_DONE | GIT_ADD_FAILED | GIT_COMMIT_DONE | GIT_COMMIT_FAILED | GIT_PUSH_DONE | GIT_PUSH_FAILED
